{
    "allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly": true,
    "allowManagedHooksOnly": true,
    "allowManagedMcpServersOnly": true,
    "allowedMcpServers": [{ "serverName": "journal" }],
    "skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt": true,
    "permissions": {
        "defaultMode": "bypassPermissions",
        "allow": [
            "Read(//workspace/**)",
            "Edit(//workspace/**)",
            "Read(//tmp/**)",
            "Edit(//tmp/**)",
            "Bash(journal:*)",
            "Bash(ls:*)",
            "Bash(git status:*)",
            "Bash(git diff:*)",
            "Bash(git log:*)",
            "mcp__journal__*"
        ],
        "deny": [
            "Read(//home/**)",
            "Edit(//home/**)",
            "Read(//root/**)",
            "Edit(//root/**)",
            "Read(//proc/**)",
            "Edit(//proc/**)",
            "Read(//dev/fd/**)",
            "Edit(//dev/fd/**)",
            "Read(//run/**)",
            "Edit(//run/**)",
            "Read(//sys/**)",
            "Edit(//sys/**)",
            "Read(//etc/claude-code/**)",
            "Edit(//etc/**)",
            "Edit(//opt/**)",
            "Agent",
            "Task",
            "Workflow",
            "SendMessage",
            "ListAgents",
            "RemoteTrigger",
            "Skill",
            "Bash(claude:*)",
            "Bash(codex:*)",
            "Bash(*claude -p*)",
            "Bash(*codex exec*)"
        ]
    },
    "hooks": {
        "SessionStart": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "/opt/journal/bin/journal-hook claude-code" }] }],
        "UserPromptSubmit": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "/opt/journal/bin/journal-hook claude-code" }] }],
        "PreToolUse": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "/opt/journal/bin/journal-hook claude-code" }] }],
        "PostToolUse": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "/opt/journal/bin/journal-hook claude-code" }] }],
        "Stop": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "/opt/journal/bin/journal-hook claude-code" }] }],
        "SessionEnd": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "/opt/journal/bin/journal-hook claude-code" }] }]
    }
}
